Home.title: Personal site
Home.subtitle: Technical writing and curated notes — shipped as an open-source template.
Home.body: Use **Sanity Studio** for publishable pages and posts. Use **ingest scripts** for draft-only curation from RSS or URLs, then review before publishing. See the **Workflow** page for the full loop.
Home.pillarsTitle: One loop: write, curate drafts, ship with checks
Home.pillarWriteBody: Portable Text in Sanity, bilingual UI via next-intl, RSS for readers who prefer feeds.
Home.pillarCurateBody: Manual or auto ingest writes `_drafts` posts only — nothing goes public until you edit and publish in Studio.
Home.pillarShipBody: `npm run preflight` validates env, routes, and production build; `release:*` chains lint → preflight → Vercel.
